content.text:
Anthropic’s prospectus details losses, growth, and, yes, a warning that its AI could end humanity: Dated 10:13 PM PDT on Sep. 28, the article says Reuters first reported prospectus financial details on Monday and summarizes Anthropic’s reported $518 billion in cloud, computing, and infrastructure plans. It also relays Financial Times reporting of $11.5 billion Q2 2026 revenue and a second consecutive quarter of adjusted operating profit. (time=2026-09-29T05:13:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
SpaceX’s Anthropic Compute Deal Worth Up to $40 Billion: The May report described an agreement worth up to $40 billion, with monthly payments through May 2029, and said either party could end it with 90 days’ notice. (time=2026-05-20T23:31:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Anthropic says it expects to spend at least $518 billion over a decade on AI infrastructure: The Reuters search result attributes to a confidential IPO prospectus at least $518 billion in infrastructure commitments over a decade with six partners, about 80% non-cancelable or payable regardless of usage, and a $31.4 billion Microsoft commitment with limited cancellation rights. (time=2026-09-29; cutoff=UNKNOWN).
Anthropic Discloses up to $84.5 Billion in SpaceX Compute Agreements: The search result reports up to $84.5 billion for SpaceX Nvidia-based compute through 2029, citing the confidential prospectus as reported by Reuters. The result does not establish when this report first appeared. (time=UNKNOWN; cutoff=UNKNOWN).
